# vbrdnk-claude-core

Personal Claude Code plugin marketplace — skills and agents for web and backend engineering.

## Installation

Add this as a marketplace source in Claude Code, then install individual plugins:

```bash
/plugin marketplace add github:vbrdnk/vbrdnk-claude-core
```

Then install any plugin individually:

```bash
/plugin install <plugin-name>@vbrdnk-claude-core
```

## Skills

| Plugin | Install | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `clarify` | `/plugin install clarify@vbrdnk-claude-core` | Transform ambiguous requests into clear specs (ASSESS → ASK → ARCHITECT → ACT) |
| `code-cleanup` | `/plugin install code-cleanup@vbrdnk-claude-core` | Refactor TypeScript/React code using simplification patterns |
| `code-optimize` | `/plugin install code-optimize@vbrdnk-claude-core` | Optimize code for performance, memory, and efficiency |
| `commit` | `/plugin install commit@vbrdnk-claude-core` | Generate Conventional Commits messages from git diff and commit |
| `google-docs` | `/plugin install google-docs@vbrdnk-claude-core` | Create/edit Google Docs with diagram rendering (Mermaid, PlantUML, Graphviz) |

## Agents

| Plugin | Install | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `backend-architect` | `/plugin install backend-architect@vbrdnk-claude-core` | Design reliable backend systems — data integrity, security, fault tolerance |
| `backend-code-reviewer` | `/plugin install backend-code-reviewer@vbrdnk-claude-core` | Expert review for Java/microservices — gRPC, REST, JUnit/Mockito |
| `frontend-architect` | `/plugin install frontend-architect@vbrdnk-claude-core` | Accessible, performant UIs with modern frameworks |
| `frontend-code-reviewer` | `/plugin install frontend-code-reviewer@vbrdnk-claude-core` | Expert review for TypeScript/React — Redux Toolkit, Styled Components, GraphQL |
| `gemini-researcher` | `/plugin install gemini-researcher@vbrdnk-claude-core` | Research topics via web search and synthesis |
| `neovim-plugin-reviewer` | `/plugin install neovim-plugin-reviewer@vbrdnk-claude-core` | Expert review of Neovim plugins — Lua, snacks.nvim, lazy.nvim |
| `refactoring-expert` | `/plugin install refactoring-expert@vbrdnk-claude-core` | Systematic refactoring and technical debt reduction |
| `tech-stack-researcher` | `/plugin install tech-stack-researcher@vbrdnk-claude-core` | Technology choices and architecture guidance for new features |

## Structure

```
vbrdnk-claude-core/
└── plugins/
    ├── clarify/
    ├── code-cleanup/
    ├── code-optimize/
    ├── commit/
    ├── google-docs/
    ├── backend-architect/
    ├── backend-code-reviewer/
    ├── frontend-architect/
    ├── frontend-code-reviewer/
    ├── gemini-researcher/
    ├── neovim-plugin-reviewer/
    ├── refactoring-expert/
    └── tech-stack-researcher/
```

Each plugin follows the standard structure:

```
<plugin-name>/
├── .claude-plugin/
│   └── plugin.json
├── skills/<skill-name>/SKILL.md   # for skill plugins
└── agents/<agent-name>.md         # for agent plugins
```
